tool_args.rationale: Fit the guided saturating siphon base and square-root branch numerically, allowing rho to escape its narrow source-derived range if the observations require it. Fresh confirmation will test generalization.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five pilot rows identify the three-parameter guided model over a substantial gradient span; confirmation is more economical than an additional probe.
The supplied branch guidance gives a present-variable quantitative law, and no unresolved temporal ambiguity warrants a trajectory batch.
